proseErrata.after: 例如，60 kW 负载在功率因数 0.9 时为 66.7 kVA；增加 25% 余量后为 83.3 kVA，因此四个 40 kVA 模块可提供 N+1。384 V、100 Ah、两组并联的电池，在 DOD 80%、效率 92%、老化系数 80% 时，计入负载相关放电影响之前的可用能量约为 45.2 kWh。

Un banco de 384 V y 100 Ah, con dos cadenas, DOD del 80 %, eficiencia del 92 % y factor de envejecimiento del 80 %, ofrece unos 45,2 kWh antes de considerar los efectos de descarga dependientes de la carga.

proseErrata.before: Base bitrate comes from the resolution and codec tier, then scales linearly with frame rate. Total bandwidth adds 20% for protocol and burst headroom. Raw NVR capacity uses Mbps × days × 0.0108 to get decimal gigabytes, then terabytes. Recommended usable capacity keeps another 15%. The uplink is twice the total bandwidth, rounded up to 1/10/25/40/100G.
proseErrata.after: Base bitrate comes from the resolution and codec tier, then scales linearly with frame rate. Total bandwidth adds 20% for protocol and burst headroom. Raw NVR capacity uses Mbps × days × 0.0108 to get decimal terabytes (TB). Recommended usable capacity keeps another 15%. The uplink is twice the total bandwidth, rounded up to 1/10/25/40/100G.
proseErrata.scope: Previously authorized storage-unit method GB→TB display correction, 20%/15% assumptions retained.
